reasons.abbrev-long-json: fix 1: --json prints only JSON (no Bare repo header)
reasons.add-glob-branch: fix 7: branch existence is an exact ref lookup, so ma* no longer matches main
reasons.add-normal-clone: fix 6: in a regular clone wt add needs an explicit path instead of nesting the worktree inside the checkout
reasons.init-clone-fails: fix 4: a failed init removes the directory it created
reasons.init-credential-url: fix 4 and 9: partial setup removed; URL credentials shown as ***
reasons.init-into-file: fix 5: a file at the target path is a clear error instead of a NotADirectoryError traceback
reasons.init-release-default: fix 3: a default branch with a slash (release/2026) is kept whole; its worktree dir is release-2026
reasons.list-json-empty: fix 1: --json prints only JSON (no Bare repo header)
reasons.list-json-korean: fix 1: --json prints only JSON (no Bare repo header)
reasons.list-json-mixed: fix 1: --json prints only JSON (no Bare repo header)
reasons.rm-locked-fails: fix 10: the worktree-removal failure lines are in English like the rest of the output
reasons.rm-suffix-in: fix 2: identifiers match whole trailing path components, so in no longer matches main and feat-login
reasons.status-json-empty: fix 1: --json prints only JSON (no Bare repo header)
reasons.status-json-mixed: fix 1: --json prints only JSON (no Bare repo header)
reasons.usage-version: P1: wt --version prints wt <version> (1.x had no such option)
